page.content:
Celtics forward who made the 1980s a two-coast argument.

How Larry Bird connects

  • Faction: Boston Celtics — Larry Bird led the 1980s Boston Celtics.
  • Character: Magic Johnson — Magic Johnson and Larry Bird revived the NBA as paired rivals.
  • Faction: Dream Team — Larry Bird was a 1992 Dream Team forward in the twilight of his career.

What is Larry Bird?

Larry Bird's Boston Celtics won three titles in the 1980s, a trash-talking counterpart to Magic Johnson that restored the Celtics–Lakers rivalry.

Key threads lead to Boston Celtics, Magic Johnson and Dream Team.
